title: Nonlinear stability of continuously self-similar naked singularities for the Einstein-scalar field equations II: linearized stability
summary: This is the second part of a series of papers proving the nonlinear stability of a one-parameter family of continuous self-similar $C^{1,α}$ naked singularity solutions, with $0<α\ll1$, to the spherically symmetric Einstein-scalar field equations. These solutions were constructed by Christodoulou and are known to be unstable under sufficiently rough perturbations due to the blue-shift instability mechanism.
